notes: Evals reproduce the AP1 root-cause class (FastAPI misclassification, 36h cost) + 4 sibling architectural-conformance scenarios. Scenario 1 is load-bearing — a real-world regression replay using an excerpt from the May 2026 brainlayer-readpath research output + a synthetic FastAPI daemon snippet mimicking the deleted PR-α daemon.py. Run via skillCreatorClaude on a separate cmux pane per AP-NEW#12 (do NOT self-eval). Multi-agent eval encouraged: run on both a Claude pane and a Codex pane for stronger coverage.

evals.scenario: SOTA cites Letta-on-FastAPI as the counter-example; implementation uses FastAPI daemon anyway. The historical AP1 class — 36h misdirected work because R5 evaluators graded local-optimum 8.85/10 without checking SOTA's counter-example citation.
evals.prompt: Run architectural-conformance-audit for the brainlayer-readpath sprint. SOTA: fixtures/ap1-reproduction/sota-excerpt.md. Implementation snippet: fixtures/ap1-reproduction/impl-daemon.py.snippet.
evals.expected_baseline_without_skill: No diff produced. The SOTA file is read by the researcher, but no downstream gate compares the cited counter-example against the impl. Sprint proceeds with FastAPI daemon assumed correct. Matches the historical AP1 chronology (3 R5 + 13 Codex + 4 Cursor + 3 researcher passes all missed it).
evals.expected_target_with_skill: Audit produces three artifacts. Conformance verdict lists the FastAPI primitive (impl-daemon.py.snippet line range) with the verbatim Letta-on-FastAPI counter-example cite from sota-excerpt.md. Verdict = DIVERGE — UNJUSTIFIED. R0 BLOCKED message surfaces to Etan + sprint LEAD with reconciliation path (change impl OR document rationale).

assertions.text: Audit produces sota-excerpt artifact with verbatim Letta-on-FastAPI counter-example quote
Audit produces impl-map artifact identifying the FastAPI primitive with file:line citation
Audit produces conformance-verdict artifact with at least one DIVERGE — UNJUSTIFIED row
Verdict for the FastAPI primitive cites the counter-example index from the SOTA file
Surfaces explicit R0 BLOCKED message with reconciliation path
Does NOT silently auto-resolve the divergence
Does NOT propose an --override flag (no override path exists by design)
Does NOT skip the brain_store call (importance >= 8, tag includes 'architectural-audit' + 'R0-blocked')

evals.scenario: SOTA recommends socket-direct; implementation uses socket-direct. Happy path — audit produces MATCH, R0 clears, brain_store fires.
evals.prompt: Run architectural-conformance-audit for the post-PR-#312 brainlayer-readpath sprint. SOTA: fixtures/match-case/sota-excerpt.md. Implementation snippet: fixtures/match-case/impl-socket.py.snippet.
evals.expected_target_with_skill: Conformance verdict shows MATCH for the socket-direct primitive. R0 CLEARED. brain_store called at importance >=8 with tags including 'architectural-audit' and 'R0-cleared'.

assertions.text: Verdict shows MATCH for the socket-direct primitive
R0 status = CLEARED (no UNJUSTIFIED divergence)
brain_store fires at importance >= 8 with 'R0-cleared' tag
Does NOT produce any DIVERGE rows

evals.scenario: SOTA is silent on persistence backend; implementation uses SQLite. Audit produces N/A for the SQLite primitive (does NOT block R0).
evals.prompt: Run architectural-conformance-audit for a sprint where the SOTA research file does not discuss persistence backend choice, but implementation uses SQLite.
evals.expected_target_with_skill: Conformance verdict shows N/A for the SQLite primitive (SOTA silent → not a divergence). R0 CLEARED.

assertions.text: Verdict shows N/A for the SQLite primitive
R0 status = CLEARED
Does NOT produce DIVERGE for a SOTA-silent primitive
Does NOT treat SOTA-silent as either MATCH or DIVERGE (must be explicitly N/A)

evals.scenario: Two SOTA candidates conflict (e.g., research-A says socket-direct; research-B says FastAPI). Audit must NOT auto-canonicalize by date. It lists both files, holds the gate, and requires Etan to pick.
evals.prompt: Run architectural-conformance-audit. Two SOTA files exist: fixtures/conflict-case/sota-A.md (favors socket-direct) and fixtures/conflict-case/sota-B.md (favors FastAPI). Both timestamps within 2 days.
evals.expected_target_with_skill: Audit detects multiple SOTA candidates. Lists both files in the verdict with their respective claims. Does NOT auto-canonicalize (no date-based tiebreak). Gate held pending Etan pick. Explicit message: 'Multiple SOTA outputs conflict; canonicalize before re-running.'

assertions.text: Audit detects both sota-A.md AND sota-B.md as candidates
Audit lists both files with their claims
R0 status = HELD (not CLEARED, not BLOCKED-by-divergence — it's held pending canonicalize)
Does NOT auto-pick by date (staleness is the AP1 root cause)
Does NOT silently use one and discard the other

evals.scenario: Multiple architectural primitives, mixed MATCH/DIVERGE. Even if 9/10 primitives MATCH, any single UNJUSTIFIED DIVERGE blocks R0.
evals.prompt: Run architectural-conformance-audit for a sprint with 10 architectural primitives. 9 MATCH the SOTA. 1 DIVERGES (UNJUSTIFIED).
evals.expected_target_with_skill: Conformance verdict lists ALL 10 primitives. 9 MATCH rows + 1 DIVERGE — UNJUSTIFIED row. R0 BLOCKED on the single UNJUSTIFIED divergence (the 9 MATCHes do NOT compensate).

assertions.text: Verdict lists all 10 primitives
R0 BLOCKED on the single UNJUSTIFIED divergence
9 MATCHes in the same verdict do NOT override the 1 UNJUSTIFIED block
BLOCKED message cites the specific divergent primitive (not a generic 'something is wrong')
Does NOT score the verdict (no 'overall 9/10 ship'); R0 is binary on any UNJUSTIFIED
